label: Basic ground-level painting — no HRCW, no CCVS

project_meta.principal_contractor: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd
project_meta.pcbu_name: Robertson's Remedial and Painting Pty Ltd

tasks.scope: Pressure wash and sand all painted surfaces before application
hazards: Slip on wet surface — fall injury
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: surface wet and barricades not in place
admin: SDS for all products reviewed before use

responsibility.WKR: Perform prep per SWMS, report hazards

tasks.scope: Apply primer, intermediate and topcoat per specification
hazards: Skin sensitisation from epoxy primer — chemical burns
controls: Chemical-resistant gloves worn at all times
Natural ventilation maintained — doors and windows open
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: ventilation not available or SDS not on site
admin: SDS for all epoxy and primer products reviewed
Wet film thickness checks during application

responsibility.WKR: Apply coating per spec, wear PPE
